// REQ: LANG-2411 LANG-2412 LANG-2413 LANG-2414
package config
import "strings"
// Schema
#Person: {
    name:  string & strings.MinRunes(1)
    age:   int & >=0 & <=150 | *30
    email?: =~"^.+@.+$"
}
ann: #Person & {name: "Ann", age: 30}
greeting: "Hello, \(ann.name)!"
for k, v in {a: 1} { "item_\(k)": v + 0x1F }
